=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2932-2936 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The edited comment above `_merge_lease_max_holders` says an empty value "uses 2 and prints one ::warning:: to stderr". In the code, line 2942 (`[ -n "${lease_mh_raw}" ] || lease_mh_raw=2`) replaces an empty or whitespace-only value with 2 and prints no warning.
  WHY: Behaviour is correct and matches the tests `("", "2", False)` and `(" ", "2", False)` in tests/test_merge_lease.py test_max_holders_validation, but the comment would mislead a maintainer who checks `::warning::` lines in consumer CI logs. All three reviewers rated it NIT. glm cited lines 2934-2935.
- changelog.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md:2-4 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The unreleased Phase 5 fragment still says "default `1`", says a non-integer value "uses 1 with a warning" and says "nothing changes with the default of `1`". The new changelog.d/10124-merge-lease-two-holders-default.md says the default is `2`.
  WHY: The next `@stable` release folds both fragments into the same notes, so consumer upgrade notes will contradict each other. Consumers will not learn that they get two holders as soon as they sync, or that `MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS=1` is the rollback. Source severity was MAJOR. minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash report the same deliverable as a task gap (see CONSENSUS TASK GAPS).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The README row and the script comments say `2`, keep the 1 to 5 range, and state that `1` restores the single-holder lease."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, the Phase 5 merge-lease behaviour comment block, lines 2859-2861 (block 2848-2870)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Lines 2859-2861 still read "One holder is written in the v1 shape, so with the default of 1 the code path, record bytes, log lines and API calls are those of Phases 1-4". The PR changed lines 2846-2854 of the same block to "default 2 since #10124" and changed the docstring at 2932-2936 but left this sentence, so the block now gives two different defaults. The sentence should say "with 1" or "with MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS=1".
- requirement: "The README, script comments, tests that check the default, and the changelog and agents fragments say `2`." / "Consumers get the change at the next `@stable` sync."
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md, lines 2 and 4
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No PR hunk touches changelog.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md. Line 2 still says "`MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS`, default `1`" and "uses 1 with a warning". Line 4 still says "nothing changes with the default of `1`" and tells consumers to set `2` only after the `@stable` sync and one week of K1-K4 readings. This contradicts changelog.d/10124-merge-lease-two-holders-default.md when scripts/assemble_changelog.py folds both into CHANGELOG.md. The files_touched grant covers changelog.d/*.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- changelog.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md:Line 2, Line 4 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unreleased Phase 5 fragment says "(`MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS`, default `1`)", says "uses 1 with a warning" and says "nothing changes with the default of `1`". The new changelog.d/10124-merge-lease-two-holders-default.md says the default is `2`. CHANGELOG.md does not mention MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS. The PR updated agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md:2 and README.md:172 but not this fragment.
  WHY: The release notes will contradict each other, and consumers will not learn that they get two holders on sync or that `MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS=1` restores the single-holder lease. Fix: change line 2 to "default `2` since #10124" and "uses 2 with a warning", and rewrite line 4 to match.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:Lines 2932-2936 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment groups "(or is empty)" with the case that prints a ::warning::, but line 2942 `[ -n "${lease_mh_raw}" ] || lease_mh_raw=2` replaces an empty value silently. The tests `("", "2", False)` and `(" ", "2", False)` assert no warning.
  WHY: Behaviour is correct, but the comment misleads a maintainer who audits warnings. README.md:172 and agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md:2 state the warning scope correctly.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Requirement: "The README row and the script comments say `2`, keep the 1 to 5 range, and state that `1` restores the single-holder lease."
  Expected change site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, the Phase 5 block comment above the merge-lease helpers, lines 2859-2861.
  Evidence of absence: Lines 2859-2861 still read "...with the default of 1 the code path, record bytes, log lines and API calls are those of Phases 1-4." The hunk at 2846-2854 changed this block to "default 2 since #10124", so the block now gives two different defaults.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: There is no runtime defect, but the comment is factually wrong and would mislead a maintainer who audits `::warning::` emission.

  Expected change site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, the merge-lease behavior comment near line 2860.
  Evidence of absence: The PR updates lines 2848-2852 and 2932-2936 but leaves lines 2859-2861 ("with the default of 1 the code path, record bytes, log lines and API calls are those of Phases 1-4."). This is the only "default of 1" left in the script.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
